description_en: Rolls back an upgraded service instance to its previous version

kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier rollback-service-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-3a8f9a75da074f52b969 --client-token 10CM943JP0EN9D51H --region cn-hangzhou
name: RollbackServiceInstance

Status.description_en:
The deployment status of the service instance. Valid values:

Created: The service instance is created.

Deploying: The service instance is being deployed.

DeployedFailed: The deployment of the service instance failed.

Deployed: The service instance is deployed.

Upgrading: The service instance is being upgraded.

UpgradeRollbacking: The service instance is being rolled back.

Deleting: The service instance is being deleted.

Deleted: The service instance is deleted.

DeletedFailed: The deletion of the service instance failed
Status.description_zh:
服务实例的部署状态。可能值：

Created：已创建

Deploying：部署中

DeployedFailed：部署失败

Deployed：已部署

Upgrading：升级中

UpgradeRollbacking 回滚中

Deleting：删除中

Deleted：已删除

DeletedFailed：删除失败
